lesson.title: Wonder as Cosmic Connector
lesson.topic: Exploring how wonder about the cosmos fosters a deeper connection to reality and others through shared inquiry.
lesson.steelman: How can cultivating a sense of cosmic wonder enhance both personal growth and communal understanding?
lesson.example: Examining the impact of the Hubble Space Telescope images on public perception of space exploration and scientific curiosity.

rationale: Encourages a sense of connection to something larger than oneself, vital for both personal development and community engagement.
